responsibility: Provides the crate’s lightweight JSON conversion layer used to serialize rustc_target data into `serde_json` values. It defines a shared `ToJson` trait and implementations for common primitives, collections, selected ABI enums, and target metadata so target specifications and related compiler data can be emitted in a consistent JSON form.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `spec/json.rs`, this is the crate-wide JSON utility layer: it only defines the shared `ToJson` trait and generic/value-level conversions for primitives, collections, ABI calling conventions, and `TargetMetadata`. It does not know the target-spec field schema, parse JSON into `Target`, or handle target-spec validation/warnings.
